name: reflect
description: Notices when you give Claude a lasting rule ("never use em dashes") and asks where to save it: a global rules file, Claude's memory, your vault, or nowhere. Nothing is saved without your choice.

rulesFile.title: File for "Save everywhere"
rulesFile.description: Absolute path of the file that gets the rule. Empty means ~/.claude/rules/reflect.md, which Claude Code loads in every project.

vaultFolder.title: Rules folder for "Save to vault"
vaultFolder.description: Absolute path of the folder in your vault or second brain where each rule becomes a note. Empty hides the vault button.
